## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant checks locally.
- [ ] I tested the affected component or docs flow.
- [ ] I considered keyboard navigation, screen readers, and reduced motion.
- [ ] I updated documentation and examples when behavior changed.
- [ ] I regenerated registry and agent resources when a registry component changed.

## Screenshots or recording

Add visual evidence for UI or motion changes when useful.
